generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Pre-qualification conditions are explained in tender booklet. Interested bidders shall abide by the rules and conditions mentioned in the standard tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

We hereby declare that we have carefully read, fully understood, and unconditionally accept and agree to all the general conditions, statutory regulations,labor welfare rules,safety requirements, and procedural instructions specified in the tender document pagenumber 6 to 9.

technicalCriterionList.description: The prospective bidder should have satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor at least one similar nature of work that is, maintenance or repair of radial gates pertaining to dams of value not less than Rs, 12.54 lakhs with GST in any reputed Industry/ PSU/ Government organization in the preceding five years (i.e., 2021-22,2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof of this, the bidder should submit a copy of single work order of value not less than Rs. 12.54 lakhs with GST and corresponding satisfactory performance/work done certificate issued by the competent authority(in case of state/central Government/Government undertakings from officers not below the rank of Chief Engineer)shall be furnished.
Agency shall upload work order pertaining to the workdone certificate uploaded.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have in the last five financial years (i.e 2021-22,2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.25.08 lakhs In proof of this Turnover Certificate duly certified by Chartered Accountant shall be furnished. (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous annual turnover to bring the current FY price level ).

itemList.description: Dismantling of existing rubber seals,clamps, two side and one bottom seal including, gas cutting. labours, machines, consumable etc., ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Supply of Z type side rubber seal as per specification and drawings at BP dam. ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Supply of Bottom rubber seal for radial gate at bp dam as per drawings along with other accessories. ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Supply of 45 bulb side rubber seal as per drawing for radial gate stop log elements. ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Supply of bottom rubber seal for seven crest stop log elements.along with all accessories. ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Dismantling of stop log elements side rubber seal and bottom seal inclding all machniries,labour etc. ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Fixing of side and bottom seal at Stop log elements including necessary clamp plates ,labours, machines, consumable etc., ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Supply of GI M12x100mm bolts for stop log elements numbers vary as per site conditions as per IS ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Supply of GI M16x75mm bolts along with nut and washer for radial gates numbers vary as per site conditions as per IS ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Fixing of side seals, bottom seals of radial gates inclduding supply and fixing of 75x75x8mm angle for side seal, bottom seal plate at BP dam. including, gas cutting, punching, drilling of clamps of seals, clamp,angles,tightning bolts,nuts, washers,including labours, machines, consumable etc., ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Labour charges towards operation of 80T crest gantry crane for lowering and lifting & stacking of crest stoplog elements for replacement of rubber seals and T-girder repairs  at Bommanalli pick up dam and removal of honey bees.  (The labour includes skilled crane operator,skilled khalasi and heavy mazdoor) ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Dismantling of damaged T -girder of radial gate No 01 and 02 and damaged stop log legs including all machines, labours and consumable including grinding. ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Fabrication of T -girder half ISMB 300 and with 10mm gusset plate for radial gate No 01 and 02 including surface prepeartion and leveling: Design, fabrication, supply, erection, testing and commissioning of radial gate consisting of skin plate, stiffeners, horizontal girders, sector ams, trunnion  assemblies, tie beam,  pulley supports, bracings,  rubber seals, clamps with all accessories for spillway including cost of  all materials, machinery, labour, cutting, bending, aligning, anchoring,  welding, finishing, cleaning, applying one coat of  zinc rich epoxy primer and three coats of cold applied coal tar epoxy  paint, seal fixing and all other ancillary operations complete as per specifications  and approved drawings. . ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.

Replacement of damaged stop log legs:esign,  fabrication,  supply,  erection,  testing  and   commissioning  of vertical  lift sliding  type  all  interchangeable (except  bottom  element) stoplog gate elements consisting of  skin plate, horizontal and  vertical girders, stiffeners, lifting pins, bronze padded slide blocks,  guide shoes, rubber seals, clamps with all accessories  for spillway  including  cost ,of all materials, machinery, labour, cutting, aligning, welding, finishing, cleaning,  applying one coat of  zinc rich epoxy primer and  three  coats cold  applied  coal  tar epoxy  paint,  seal  fixing   and all other ancillary operations complete as per specifications and approved drawings. ---- Quoted rate shall be excluding GST.Agency must quote for all the items.Partially / abnormally quoted tenders will be rejected.
